# netactuate_vpc_backend_template (Resource)

Manages a VPC Backend Template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_vpc_backend_template" "example" {
  name   = "example"
  vpc_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the backend template
- `vpc_id` (Number) The ID of the parent VPC

### Optional

- `backend_host` (Block List) Backend hosts in this template (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--backend_host))
- `description` (String) Description of the backend template

### Read-Only

- `backend_template_id` (Number) The backend template ID assigned by the API
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--backend_host"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backend_host`

Required:

- `address` (String) IP address of the backend host
- `name` (String) Name of the backend host

Read-Only:

- `backend_host_id` (Number) The backend host ID assigned by the API

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_vpc_backend_template.example 12345
```
